# Marklo AI

Marklo AI is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Marklo is a marketing calendar and planning platform for Shopify DTC brands. It automates cross-channel reporting, surfaces campaign insights, and makes planning and briefing 10x faster. Marklo AI employs 9 people (+500.0% YoY, +5 people), founded in 2025. Headquartered in San Mateo, California, United States.

## About

About Marklo:
Marklo exists so lean businesses can market like bigger brands, moving fast and in the right direction. We're building the AI revenue planner for brand-led commerce teams: one platform that turns your marketing history into a day-by-day, year-over-year source of truth, then plans what to run next.

In a world where marketing is chaotic and tools are fragmented, Marklo unifies your commerce and marketing stack (product, customer, inventory, and campaign history) into one clear commercial picture. Our Hindsight Calendar is the marketer's control tower, surfacing what to run, when, and why, with a brief ready for your review, not a decision made without you.

Backed by Forerunner Ventures and led by serial entrepreneur Jessica Herrin (Stella & Dot, Ever Skincare, WeddingChannel.com), Marklo is building the platform that helps lean teams execute like bigger brands and win.

# MarloAI

MarloAI is a Technology, Information and Internet company. MarloAI employs 2 people.

## About

Marlo is the platform and the team that run your marketing.

We are a marketing operating system for consumer brands. Marlo works inside the stack you already own, runs the work across every channel, and drives sales you can see.

Both nouns matter. The platform reads signals, drafts in your locked brand voice, and ships through the tools you already pay for. Senior operators own the work and sign it.

Three layers do that job:
- Intelligence reads every signal across your category and your competitors, continuously.
- Execution ships the work end to end, senior operators and a vetted creative network alongside the platform.
- Memory keeps the briefs, the results, and the reasons no channel tool keeps. Every cycle makes the next one sharper.

Six channels run today: Social, CRM and lifecycle, Local, Paid media, Search including AI answer engines, and Reviews. Each is one surface of the same operating system. Underneath sits the Library, our research corpus: 29.8M signals, including 18M+ posts, 890K+ reviews, 1.2M+ competitor ads, and $3.2B in tracked ad spend across 60+ platforms.

We co-build every engagement with your team. Four depths, each inheriting the last: Inform, Draft, Run, and Enterprise. Your data, your results, your control.
